<!-- pr-reviewer: 795d69e9526468ef9dc717587625a6b12e0ca4f1 -->
Needs changes before merge.

What looks good
- Closing overlap, real and pinned: `ring::past_seam` rides the seam edge's own remainder back to the seam, so a stated 100 mm overlap covers exactly 100.000 mm, forward and reversed, and a ride past one full lap is refused by name (motion tests, both directions and near the perimeter).
- Centre slit, real and pinned: the wire rides the run itself (`sign = 0.0` in `open.rs`), the kerf law is skipped by statement and the ends are still judged, the run-out clearance rides the generation stamp (`cutting.rs`), and the verify line says the law was skipped (`CENTRE_SKIP`).
- Open-run skims, real: each pass re-enters from the air at its own run-in point; a travel rapid marks the boundary; verify splits at the boundary and judges each pass at its own kerf (`split_open`); the post announces each skim after the travel (`announce_skims`); a new golden pins the Right case.
- Unsupported combinations refused by name at the command door: `overlap_refusal` for burnout / 4-axis / taper (create and edit pinned per combination); the overlap is refused at `condition_of` and again at generation.
- Both sides kept in the hand-resolved files at the head's merge: the exit-pick refusal beside the overlap refusal (wire_op.rs), the overlap row and Centre hints beside main's start/exit groups (wire_page.rs).
- Process metadata: the body carries `Process change: yes` and `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3216`; `PROCESS_VERSION` untouched; no new dependencies, no build.rs / .github / scripts / xtask / .cargo changes, no snapshot PNG changes; the one new golden is the intended new output.

Results
Not built. This machine has no C toolchain (no cc / gcc / clang on PATH, and no cc1 anywhere), so the workspace cannot start a build. The runner path is not available for this PR: the author is a fork contributor with read permission only, and the pr-test workflow only runs for collaborators with push access ("Collaborators only"). So no suite, no clippy, no light lane - all "not run", not "pass".

Exact failure, on a fresh worktree of this head:

```
$ cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run
   Compiling crc32fast v1.5.2
   Compiling aho-corasick v1.1.5
   Compiling svgtypes v0.15.3
error: linker `cc` not found
  |
  = note: No such file or directory (os error 2)
error: could not compile `crc32fast` (build script) due to 1 previous error
```

Author-reported on the refreshed head 795d69e95 (not independently verified): motion lib 668 passed, sim lib 253 passed, app lib 311 passed, ui lib 1659 passed; mcp_wire_contour 8, wire_verify 3, golden_cl 34, wire_post 13, wire_stamp 8, wire_contour 19, wire_burnout 4, wire_taper 11, wire_4axis 8, conformance 7; clippy app + motion + sim + ui --all-targets -D warnings clean; example_catalog's 2d/drill-overfeed refusal.txt CRLF red is the known environmental #3628.

Targeted tests
- The quick plan and the touched binaries are not runnable here (compiler missing) - not run.
- Example catalog suites by name (post/toolpath changed): not run - blocked. The body's conformance 7 is author-reported.
- `cargo xtask gate light` (required at review): not run - blocked by the missing compiler.
- Heavy lanes: not owed. This is a P6 feature, not a P1 under the safety floor.

Requested before merge
1. Class: conflicts with main. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page_tests.rs` - merge current main (baad348f1) into the branch (a merge, never a rebase). Both sides append at the same anchor: the PR's `wire_closing_overlap_and_centre_side_apply_and_undo` (line 252 in the trial merge) and main's #3996 `open_cut_hides_the_agie_statements_for_another_wire_post` plus the `agie_post` / `open_cut` helpers (main's commit 0168ee120, "show Agie-only controls only for an Agie job"). Keep both tests; the page file auto-merges cleanly (both gates kept: `matches!(side, WireSide::Left | WireSide::Right) && agie_job(...)`). After the refresh, re-run the gate and re-review.
2. Class: Centre slit post path uncovered. `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:292` - `openRun() { return side === "left" || side === "right"; }` never covers "centre". A Centre open run with a skim reaches the post via `announce_skims` (`crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs:277`, `is_open_side()` includes Centre), so the stream carries a travel rapid; `onRapid` (`wire-iso.cps:351-354`) hits the `!openRun()` branch and refuses the whole post ("a rapid with the wire threaded through the work - refused"). The PR's body claims "an open run's skims rethread in the air between passes, each pass verified and posted at its own kerf" - true for left / right only. Also line 249 prints "SIDE CENTRE - KERF IN THE PATH" (the kerf law is skipped for Centre), line 303 says "THREAD THE WIRE AT THE START HOLE" (a Centre slit is threaded in the air at its run-in point), and line 462 says "CUT THE WIRE" instead of the run-out variant. Fix: `openRun()` matches "centre", the two note sites and the side note say the open run's words for Centre, and pin it with a Centre post test + golden (e.g. `cutoff_doc_with` with `WireSide::Centre`, mirroring `an_open_run_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts` and its golden, which is Right-only at `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/wire-iso/wire_contour_open_skims.nc`). Fix the decision record's item 3 too - it over-states what the post does for a Centre slit.
3. Class: agent-facing doc. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149` - the side list still reads `side: "die"|"punch"|"left"|"right"` and the open-run phrase `(side: "left"|"right")`; no "centre" appears, though the app, the UI, the DTO and the motion enum all carry it. Add "centre" to both places.

Questions / notes
- Style: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:207` - the `// #3207` comment is jammed on the hint line. Valid Rust, but cramped; move it onto its own line.
- The Agie open-cut rows gate on `matches!(side, WireSide::Left | WireSide::Right)` (wire_page.rs:238): a Centre slit never shows them. That matches the native post refusing Centre by name (`agie_profile.rs` maps only Punch / Die / Left / Right) - confirm this is intended.
- The stale collaborator review on head f019072d does not stand for this head: `b202b7efb` carries new code (the rework), and the branch merged main after it. A fresh review is owed; this is the one on record.
- The broad first gate pass (mkinney, f019072d) was not re-verified here - the build is blocked, so the numbers above are the author's, not a re-run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Needs changes before merge.

What looks good
- Closing overlap is real and pinned: `past_seam` rides the seam edge's own remainder to the exact arc length (forward and reversed), a ride longer than one full lap is refused by name, and a skim inherits the ride (`ring.rs`, motion `tests.rs`).
- Centre-line slit: the wire rides the run itself, the kerf law is skipped by statement (`CENTRE_SKIP`), the ends' clearance is still judged, and its stamp moves with its clearance (`params/cutting.rs`, `wire_stamp.rs`).
- Open-run skims: each pass re-enters from the air, a travel move carries no wire, verify judges each pass at its own kerf and its own ends, and the generic ISO post cuts, travels and threads anew around each boundary (`openRun()`, `onRapid`, `announce_skims` in `posting_wire.rs`). The two new goldens lock the sequence.
- The command-door and generation refusals for overlap beside a tangent arc lead (motion lib + app DXF suite), beside a burnout, a 4-axis cut, a taper (`overlap_refusal`) and tabs (`cut_pass`) are each pinned by name.
- The decision record, the `Process change: yes` line, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3216` are all present; PROCESS_VERSION is not edited by the PR; no snapshot PNGs are changed; goldens are new and explained.

Results merged with main
- Trial merge of `origin/main` (1c0152c91): no conflicts; the trial-merged tree is what the builds below ran against.
- Debug build (motion, sim, app, ui): clean. Clippy `--all-targets -D warnings`: camcraft-motion, camcraft-sim, camcraft-app, camcraft-ui all exit 0.
- motion lib wire_edm: 101 passed, 0 failed (past_seam ride, seam-remainder, one-lap refusal, centre slit, arc-lead overlap refusal).
- sim lib verify::wire: 31 passed, 0 failed (per-pass kerf and ends, centre slit).
- app: wire_dxf_selection 17, wire_post 31, wire_stamp 8, golden_cl 34, wire_taper 10, wire_burnout 4, wire_4axis 9, wire_contour 8, mcp_wire_contour 13, wire_verify 6, wire_verify_tol 7, wire_tabs 2, wire_sharp_corners 4, wire_taper_angle 5, wire_taper_chord 3, wire_tool 5, wire_readers 3, wire_fans 2 (all passing).
- ui wire_page lib: 13 passed, 0 failed (incl. the new Closing overlap row and Centre side apply/undo).
- Example catalog suites: not run - the diff changes the wire ISO post and its goldens, not the milling posts the catalog cases cover.
- Light lane: green - the light build (release --no-run) and all five light-twin steps pass: motion light lib 7 passed (11.38s), adaptive_troch_island 1 passed, adaptive_troch_neck 1 passed, adaptive_troch_parallel 1 passed, app light pocket_pass_start 1 passed (wall 14.6 min, 6 steps, 0 failed). The light lane touches no wire test - the plan covers pocket/adaptive/kernel twins only.

Requested before merge
1. Repair the corrupted process file `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (the one real defect in this PR). The committed head carries a UTF-8 BOM (line 1 is `efbb bf` + `---`) and 17 cp1252 mojibake lines: lines 23-52 in the Architecture & Principles ASCII diagram (`│` -> `â”‚`, `▼` -> `â–¼`, seven `│`/`▼` pairs), line 87 (`chain:0xâ€¦` for `…`), line 90 (`G54â€“G59` and `1â€“6` for `–`, twice), line 153 (`face:0xâ€¦` for `…`). The base file and current main are clean UTF-8 (0 mojibake, no BOM); only the branch corrupts it, and the corruption is present at the head last reviewed (5afceec04) as well as at this head. Re-save the file as clean UTF-8 without the BOM: keep the intended Wire Contour text (centre / overlap / lead_arc_radius) and main's new "Live MCP idle window" section (the trial-merged tree carries both). The corruption cannot be fixed by merging main; the branch's own file is what is corrupted.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The MCP doc edit (overlap description following `overlap`) is correct, but it is one of the lines written in the corrupted file - repair the file once and the content is already right.
- The Sodick post refuses an open-run skim at its rapid guard by name; the PR body records that as not exercised, which is honest.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ae20793aa82262efaf510a7a5625d819bb38a9a9 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The corrupted-file fix is clean: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is now valid UTF-8 with no BOM and no cp1252 mojibake (the only non-ASCII bytes are the box-drawing chars and the ellipsis in the architecture diagram and in the Sinker electrode line); the main-kept "Live MCP idle window" section is present verbatim, and the Wire Contour paragraph carries the centre side, the `overlap` field and the refusal/skim sentences. `mcp_wire_contour` pins the skill against the DTO and the tool law, so the doc cannot silently drift from the fields.
- Closing overlap is real and pinned end to end: `ring::past_seam` rides the seam edge's own remainder back to the seam, so a 100 mm overlap covers exactly 100.000 mm of arc forward and reversed, and a ride past one full lap is refused by name (motion tests, both directions, near the perimeter). The ride's note says the stated distance, never a short one.
- Centre slit and open-run skims re-enter the cut as one chained program: a rapid travel move carries the pass boundary, the verify splits on the boundaries (each pass judged at its own kerf and own ends, `split_open` refuses a mismatch by name), and the post cuts, travels and threads anew per pass - pinned by a new golden pair (`wire_contour_open_skims.nc`, `wire_contour_centre_skims.nc`) beside the unchanged rough-only open golden.
- Overlap is refused by name at the doors that it cannot ride: tabs, burnout, 4-axis, taper, tangent arc lead (both create and edit doors), and `ring::past_seam` refuses a full lap or more at generation. `overlap` rides the seed, the sanity check, the op stamp (only when stated), the DTO (absent reads 0) and the MCP field list.
- The centre slit is stamped like any open run (clearance moves the stamp), so a re-stated clearance reads Stale, not Ok with a stale path - pinned through the edit command and a reloaded project.
- Both new goldens are added, not changed: no existing golden moves.
- Trial merge against origin/main: clean, no conflicts; auto-merge of the SKILL.md conflict resolved to the union of both sides.

Results (local worktree at the head, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6, sccache)
- Motion lib `wire_edm`: 101 passed; motion wire_fans: 7 passed
- Sim lib `wire`: 31 passed
- App wire suites: wire_dxf_selection 9, wire_taper 4, wire_burnout 8, wire_4axis 17, wire_contour 6, wire_verify 7, wire_verify_tol 2, wire_tabs 4, wire_sharp_corners 13, wire_taper_angle 5, wire_taper_chord 3, wire_tool 5, wire_readers 3, wire_fans 2, wire_post 31, wire_stamp 8, golden_cl 40, mcp_wire_contour (full) 9, agie_native 34, g_edm_post 10, solid_law_goldens 7, sodick_wire_dielectric 4, sodick_wire_passes 6, sodick_wire_post 3, sodick_alc400g 5, setup_align_non_mill 8 - all green
- UI lib wire: 32 passed
- Clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): 6 steps, all ok (release build 303 s, motion lib 77 s, adaptive_troch_* ok, pocket_pass_start ok; wall 7.8 min, 0 failed) - green
- No post or toolpath catalog suites to run (this is a wire/EDM feature, not a post-render or toolpath-geometry change; example_catalog runs are not owed here).

Requested before merge
1. (none)

Notes (not blocking)
- The SKILL.md Wire Contour paragraph states the overlap refusals as "beside a burnout, a 4-axis cut or a nonzero taper" and omits the tangent arc lead refusal (`a_closing_overlap_with_an_arc_lead_is_refused_by_name_at_both_doors` in arc_lead.rs); a one-line addition would keep the doc exact.
- crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs is 463 lines (was 401) and crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs is 444 (was 425); both already over the 400-line guide, no split owed by this PR.
- Process change: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is edited; body carries "Process change: yes" and PROCESS_VERSION is untouched - consistent with AGENTS.md.
- The two new goldens ride on synth fixtures and are explainable by the generated text; no existing golden is regenerated.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
